crossRefs.note: I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill.
Yahweh is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.
Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
Who is the King of glory? Yahweh strong and mighty, Yahweh mighty in battle.
You are my King, God. Command victories for Jacob!
Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!
For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.
Yahweh reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.
I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
For Yahweh is our judge. Yahweh is our lawgiver. Yahweh is our king. He will save us.
You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.

translations.web: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God; for I pray to you.
translations.bsb: Attend to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for to You I pray.
translations.kjv: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.
translations.asv: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God; For unto thee do I pray.
